The '''Attack on Grappa the Hutt's fortress''' was a mission undertaken in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], during the [[Imperial Civil War]]. A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] force led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Mirith Sinn]] raided the [[Grappa's palace|palace]] of [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa the Hutt]] on [[Genon]] to rescue former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Imperial Royal Guard]] [[Kir Kanos]] and [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The_.22Council_of_Blood.22|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]] member [[Feena D'Asta]].<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref>

==Prelude==
During a [[Battle of Smarck|strike]] on a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] facility, [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] Commander Mirith Sinn learned of Kir Kanos' captivity by Grappa the Hutt, after his capture by the [[Zanibar]] while rescuing Sinn on [[Xo]]. After destroying Black Sun's [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility, Sinn and her force proceeded to Genon to rescue Kanos in turn.<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref>

Working with Black Sun, Grappa had abducted Feena D'Asta, and created a [[Feena D'Asta (clone)|clone]] to take her place on the Imperial Interim Ruling Council, in the very facilities destroyed in Mirith Sinn's raid. Grappa was contacted by [[Underlord]] [[Y'ull Acib]], enraged by the loss of Black Sun's cloning facilities and the absence of his subordinate [[Macus Kayniph]], who unbeknownst to Acib had been killed by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in a fit of rage. To Grappa's consternation, the Underlord announced his departure for Genon and demanded that Kayniph be held for questioning.<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref><ref name="CEII3">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 3|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 3]]</ref>

Meanwhile, acting as a go-between for the Zanibar's attempt to claim the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|imperial]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Kir Kanos, Grappa had promised [[Zzzanmxl]], their leader, nine tenths of the substantial reward, adding to his existing debt to the group.<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref><ref name="CEII3">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 3|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 3]]</ref>

==The Mission==
Taken by surprise after his communication with Y'ull Acib, Grappa the Hutt was confronted by a group of New Republic [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] led by Commander Sinn. Grappa was surprised to see [[Tav Kennede]], who he had employed, within their number, with Kennede revealing his true allegiance to Kir Kanos.<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref>

Sinn demanded that Grappa turn over Kanos and D'Asta, ordering [[T-65B X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] pilot [[Green Leader/Legends|Green Leader]] to make an attack run on Grappa's fortress at the Hutt's resistance. Conceding to the New Republic's demands, Grappa was further humiliated in being imprisoned in the cell in which Kir Kanos had been held, lamenting the consequences of his failures to both Black Sun and the Zanibar.<ref name="CEII5">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 5|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 5]]</ref>

==Aftermath==
Sinn's group departed for [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]], the capital of the Imperial Interim Ruling Council and the location of a [[Battle of Ord Cantrell|battle]] between the forces of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]], Feena D'Asta's father, and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Xandel Carivus]].<ref name="CEII6">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 6]]</ref>

Grappa was released from his cell by [[Schmood]], a [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] member of his court, discovering that [[Sol Mon]] and his [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] had abandoned him, and that his murder of Macus Kayniph had been revealed to Y'ull Acib by [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]]. With Black Sun closing in, the Hutt attempted to flee, only to be taken by the Zanibar for his failure to procure Kanos' bounty, to be used in their sacrificial ritual.<ref name="CEII6">[[Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood 6|''Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood'' 6]]</ref>
